question: Which of the following committees was responsible for making recommendations that led to the 42ⁿd Constitutional Amendment for the declaration of Fundamental Duties?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Swaran Singh Committee**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Swaran Singh Committee** was responsible for making recommendations that led to the 42nd Constitutional Amendment for the declaration of Fundamental Duties.
 
• The 42nd Amendment Act of 1976 is one of the most comprehensive amendments to the Constitution of India and is often referred to as a "mini-Constitution."
